<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">MapPolyline</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-nativebase" title="class in com.here">NativeBase</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>A visual representation of a line on the map.
 <p>The geometry to be visualized is represented by an instance of <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geopolyline" title="class in com.here.sdk.core"><code>GeoPolyline</code></a>.
 <p>Altitude component of <code>GeoPolyline</code>'s vertices is ignored.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<a id="&lt;init&gt;(com.here.sdk.core.GeoPolyline,com.here.sdk.mapview.MapPolyline.Representation)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>MapPolyline</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;MapPolyline&#8203;(@NonNull
                   <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geopolyline" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">GeoPolyline</a>&nbsp;geometry,
                   @NonNull
                   <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline.Representation</a>&nbsp;representation)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a new <code>MapPolyline</code> instance with a specified visual representation.
 <p>Altitude component of <code>GeoPolyline</code>'s vertices is ignored.
 <p>After creating a <code>MapPolyline</code> with this representation, the deprecated <code>MapPolyline</code>
 properties do not work and any change to them will be ignored. Any modifications to polyline's
 appearance must be done with <a href="#setRepresentation(com.here.sdk.mapview.MapPolyline.Representation)"><code>setRepresentation(com.here.sdk.mapview.MapPolyline.Representation)</code></a>.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>geometry</code> - <p>The list of vertices representing the polyline.</dd>
<dd><code>representation</code> - <p>The styling properties of the polyline.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</section>

<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getDrawOrder</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;int&nbsp;getDrawOrder()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the draw order of the polyline.
 <p>The default draw order is 0.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The draw order of the polyline.</dd>
</dl>

<a id="setDrawOrder(int)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setDrawOrder</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;setDrawOrder&#8203;(int&nbsp;value)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Sets the draw order of the polyline.
 <p>Polylines with a higher draw order are drawn on top
 of polylines with a lower draw order.
 <p>In case multiple polylines have the same draw
 order, they can be rendered in different ways depending on the <a href="#getDrawOrderType()"><code>getDrawOrderType()</code></a> set.
 <p>Supplied value is clamped to the range [0; 1023].</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>value</code> - <p>The draw order of the polyline.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="getDrawOrderType()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getDrawOrderType</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-drawordertype" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview">DrawOrderType</a>&nbsp;getDrawOrderType()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the draw order type of the polyline.
 <p>The default value is <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-drawordertype#MAP_SCENE_ADDITION_ORDER_DEPENDENT"><code>DrawOrderType.MAP_SCENE_ADDITION_ORDER_DEPENDENT</code></a>.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The draw order type of the polyline.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="setDrawOrderType(com.here.sdk.mapview.DrawOrderType)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setDrawOrderType</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;setDrawOrderType&#8203;(@NonNull
                             <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-drawordertype" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview">DrawOrderType</a>&nbsp;value)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Sets the draw order type of the polyline.
 <p>For <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-drawordertype#MAP_SCENE_ADDITION_ORDER_DEPENDENT"><code>DrawOrderType.MAP_SCENE_ADDITION_ORDER_DEPENDENT</code></a>, map polylines with outlines having
 the same draw order are drawn as a whole in the order of addition to a map scene. There
 is no possibility that parts of another polyline, regardless of its draw order value,
 are drawn between outline and mainline of another polyline.
 <p>With <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-drawordertype#MAP_SCENE_ADDITION_ORDER_DEPENDENT"><code>DrawOrderType.MAP_SCENE_ADDITION_ORDER_DEPENDENT</code></a>, polylines are rendered one by one.
 <p>For <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-drawordertype#MAP_SCENE_ADDITION_ORDER_INDEPENDENT"><code>DrawOrderType.MAP_SCENE_ADDITION_ORDER_INDEPENDENT</code></a>, for multiple polylines with
 outlines having the same draw order, all outlines are rendered first in an arbitrary order
 and then all mainlines are drawn on top of those polylines in an arbitrary order.
 <p><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-drawordertype#MAP_SCENE_ADDITION_ORDER_INDEPENDENT"><code>DrawOrderType.MAP_SCENE_ADDITION_ORDER_INDEPENDENT</code></a> allows speeding up the rendering
 process and keeping high frame rates when many similar polylines (with same styling
 attributes and <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapPolyline.Representation</code></a>) are present in a map scene.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>value</code> - <p>The draw order type of the polyline.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">

                                java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasurerange" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureRange</a>&gt;&nbsp;value)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Sets visibility ranges for this map polyline. A range is half open -
 [minimumZoomLevel, maximumZoomLevel), the given maximum value is not contained in the range.
 The map polyline is visible only inside these map measure ranges.
 <p>When empty (the default), the map polyline is visible without map measure restrictions.
 Only <code>MapMeasureRange</code>(s) of <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind#ZOOM_LEVEL"><code>MapMeasure.Kind.ZOOM_LEVEL</code></a> type are supported.
 <code>MapMeasureRange</code>(s) of other unsupported types will be ignored.</div>

</dl>
</li>
</ul>

<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setProgress</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;setProgress&#8203;(double&nbsp;value)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Sets the progress of the polyline from its starting point as a ratio of its total length
 clamped to the range [0; 1].
 <p>As the progress varies, the equivalent part of the
 polyline gets covered by the progress color and progress outline color. The rest of the
 polyline until its end point retains the line color and outline color along with an
 optional dash pattern.</div>

<dd><code>value</code> - <p>The progress from the polyline's starting point, as a ratio of its total length clamped to
     the range [0, 1].</dd>

</li>
</ul>

<a id="setProgressGradientLength(com.here.sdk.mapview.MapMeasureDependentRenderSize)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setProgressGradientLength</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;setProgressGradientLength&#8203;(@NonNull
                                      <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;value)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Sets the maximum gradient length between <code>MapPolyline.lineColor' and 'MapPolyline.progressColor</code> in zoom level dependent pixels.
 To achieve a constant gradient length, use <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</code></a>
 with a single value. To achieve a gradient length dependent on map zoom,
 use <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</code></a> with multiple values. The default value is a constant
 gradient length of zero pixels. The gradient is guaranteed to fit into polyline, i.e. the
 actual gradient can be shorter then <code>progressGradientLength</code>.
 <p>For <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure.Kind</code></a> only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind#ZOOM_LEVEL"><code>MapMeasure.Kind.ZOOM_LEVEL</code></a> is supported.
 For <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-rendersize-unit" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>RenderSize.Unit</code></a> only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-rendersize-unit#PIXELS"><code>RenderSize.Unit.PIXELS</code></a> is supported.
 A parameter with unsupported values is ignored.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>value</code> - <p>The maximum gradient length between <code>MapPolyline.lineColor' and 'MapPolyline.progressColor</code> in zoom level dependent pixels.</dd>
